# Swedish playable lexicon expanded from hunspell sv_SE (LibreOffice dictionaries sv_SE @ 75f5dff8c972fff4a32e4ea8434722c277f02a3f).
# The Swedish edition has A-ring, A-umlaut and O-umlaut TILES because they are separate
# letters of the alphabet, and ignores other diacritics EXCEPT U-umlaut, so:
#   * a-ring, a-umlaut and o-umlaut are PRESERVED;
#   * every other marked letter is folded to its base letter -- except u-umlaut, which
#     the edition does NOT ignore and no tile bears, so its words are dropped;
#   * a word containing any other letter no tile bears is dropped for the same reason.
# So 'cafe' is here and 'muesli' is not, in either spelling.
# Not an official tournament list.
